title: Get Deal Delivery Request
description: Request parameters for retrieving deal delivery metrics. Returns SSP-side delivery data including impressions, spend, bids, wins, and win rate.

deal_ids.description: Protocol-level deal IDs to retrieve delivery for

buyer_refs.description: Buyer reference IDs to retrieve delivery for

start_date.description: Start date for the reporting period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to deal start date if omitted.

end_date.description: End date for the reporting period (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to current date if omitted.

include_daily_breakdown.description: When true, include daily_breakdown in each deal delivery. Defaults to false.
